title: Home charging convenience and Exclude Home feature
summary: This topic combines comments about convenient home charging with a smaller set of remarks about the Exclude Home setting and one infotainment navigation frustration, while most sampled mentions lack enough context for a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the convenience of charging at home and mention interest in or appreciation for the Exclude Home-related functionality.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe frustration with a full-screen station selection flow that makes returning from the home screen cumbersome.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention home charging, wallbox setup, or the Exclude Home feature descriptively, but the fragments usually do not provide enough context to assign a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most reviews in this topic are undetermined, so the available evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
